people.name: Achan
people.line: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.

people.name: Carmi
people.line: Father of Achan, who stole devoted things

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
translations.bsb: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
